title: Nine Weeks of Growing
subtitle: 胡须与仪表 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 胡须与仪表（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：胡须与仪表（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：beard　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my uncle grew ① a beard in nine weeks and my grandmother refused to speak to him for eleven, and my mother said the silence was the whole of the beard. The ② beard, meaning the hair and not the argument, was shaved off in March and never mentioned; a beard, he said, is the only thing you can grow that a family will vote on.

Every ③ beard in that family was grown for a reason, and the ④ beard of 1961, meaning the one grown for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever admitted to. A beard, my grandmother said, is nine parts vanity and one part a cold January; my uncle said the vanity is the part they notice.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ beard was the whole of the corn, meaning the silks and not the hair. The ⑥ beard, meaning the threads on the cob and not any of that, is the only part of a crop that is named after a man's face; a beard, he said, is either something on a chin or the only word that means both hair and silk. She said the silk came first.

By 1968 the ⑦ beard had become a photograph on a wall, and the wall had become an argument about whether it suited him. The ⑧ beard of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in June, was nine weeks of growing and eleven months of silence; a beard, he said, is either the hair on his chin or the reason his mother learned to write letters. She said the letters were the better half.

The ⑨ beard I remember is the one of 1961, which was shaved before anybody had agreed about it. A ⑩ beard, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being removed; every beard, she said, is an argument that has agreed to look like hair. He said the argument was always the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 胡须（指那些毛发，与争论相对）
C. 固定搭配：grow a beard 留胡子
D. n. 胡须（指家里每一次／每一个人的）
E. n. 胡须（指 1961 年那一部）
F. n. 玉米须；（玉米的）穗丝
G. n. 玉米须（抽象：穗上那些丝）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The beard, meaning the hair and not the argument
beard was the whole of the corn
The beard, meaning the threads on the cob
the beard had become a photograph on a wall
The beard of the whole thing
A beard, my grandmother said in 1970

answers.why: grow a beard 意为“留胡子”，1955 年叔叔九周就留出了胡子，祖母十一个月没跟他说话。
beard 意为“胡须”，指那些毛发而不是争吵，它三月被剃掉，从此再没提起过。
beard 指家里每一次留胡子，那个家里每一部胡子都有理由。
beard 指 1961 年那一部（为过冬留的那一部），是唯一有人肯承认的。
beard 意为“玉米须、穗丝”，指穗上那些丝，父亲说 beard 就是玉米的全部。
beard 为抽象用法，指穗上那些丝，是一株庄稼上唯一以男人的脸来命名的部分。
beard 意为“胡须”，到 1968 年这个 beard 成了墙上的一张照片。
beard 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，叔叔六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九周的生长和十一个月的沉默。
beard 意为“胡须”，我记得的是 1961 年那一部，它还没等家里人取得一致意见就被剃了。
beard 为抽象总称，祖母说胡子是唯一会因为被剃掉而变好的东西。
